items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.summary: The New York Times is warning freelance photographers against using the latest version of Adobe Photoshop, saying it uses AI “in ways that may not be apparent to users.”

items.summaryZh: 《纽约时报》提醒自由摄影师不要使用最新版 Adobe Photoshop，称其中使用 AI 的方式“可能不会被用户察觉”。

items.title: 1Password Security Incident
items.summary: 1Password identified a security incident involving some of our backend systems. Customer vaults were not accessed and remain secure.
items.summaryZh: 1Password 发现其部分后端系统发生安全事件。客户保险库未遭访问，仍然安全。

items.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
items.summary: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.
items.titleZh: 标普考虑因治理和“关键人物”风险下调 Nvidia 信用评级
items.summaryZh: 这家信用评级机构可能将 Nvidia 的信用评级下调至 AA-，这是第四高的评级。

items.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
items.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.
items.titleZh: 美国联邦通信委员会批准 SpaceX 将 AI 数据中心送入太空的计划
items.summaryZh: 美国联邦通信委员会驳回了反对者提出的部分主要担忧，包括对科学研究的潜在威胁，理由是该机构认定这些问题不属于其监管权限。

items.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
items.summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
items.titleZh: OpenAI 称，随着 Chat 与 Work 合并，ChatGPT 重度用户可能更早触及使用上限
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 将在整合 ChatGPT 的 Chat 和 Work 体验时，推出统一的用量计量机制。

items.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
items.summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.
items.titleZh: 黄仁勋违反 Nvidia 行为准则，员工或许不会忘记
items.summaryZh: 大多数行为准则都体现了企业文化。对 Nvidia 来说，这可能带来后果。

items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
items.titleZh: Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 称“将人类控制权交给 AI”的指控荒谬
items.summaryZh: Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 反驳了竞争对手关于他主张将人类自主权交给 AI 的指控；与此同时，领先的 AI 公司正越来越多地将自身研究和模型开发自动化。

items.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
items.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
items.titleZh: 今年圣诞节想给孩子买 AI 玩具？纽约不行
items.summaryZh: 纽约州已禁止 AI 聊天机器人玩具五年。Common Sense Media 的新研究则揭示了令人担忧的安全问题，包括接触不当内容以及情感发展面临的风险。

items.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
items.summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.
items.titleZh: Character.AI 拍卖用户私人聊天记录的计划遭州检察长反对
items.summaryZh: 州检察长表示，Character.AI 拟议中的破产资产出售包含超过 2100 万个美国账户的敏感个人数据，其中有 210 万个账户注册用户为未成年人。

items.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
items.summary: The Tesla Cybertruck was the fastest-selling used truck last month, averaging just 39.1 days on the market compared to 65.5 days for trucks overall.
items.titleZh: 停产的 Tesla Cybertruck 成为美国售出速度最快的二手皮卡
items.summaryZh: 上个月，Tesla Cybertruck 是售出速度最快的二手皮卡，平均仅在市场上挂牌 39.1 天，而所有皮卡的平均时间为 65.5 天。
